portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure that all previously-released
errata relevant to your system have been applied.  

This update is available via Red Hat Network.  Details on how to use 
the Red Hat Network to apply this update are available at
http://kbase.redhat.com/faq/FAQ_58_10188
portal_description:
Evolution is the GNOME mailer, calendar, contact manager and communications
tool.  The tools which make up Evolution will be tightly integrated with
one another and act as a seamless personal information-management tool.

Bugs fixed in these updated packages include:

* unable to save an appointment or meeting in the Chinese language locale
for Taiwan.

* copy and paste from a calendar appointment did not work correctly in some
CJK/Indic languages.

Users should upgrade to this updated package, which resolves these issues.
